description: This file defines a React functional component responsible for rendering and managing the create account workflow in a web application. It includes form inputs for email and password, handles validation, and interacts with application services for user registration.

classes.name: CreateAccount
classes.description: A React Functional Component that renders the create account form and manages its state and side-effects.

methods.name: handleEmailChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the email input, resetting validation flags.

methods.name: handlePasswordChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the password input.

methods.name: handleConfirmPasswordChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the confirm password input, resetting mismatch flags.

methods.name: handleSignInInstead
methods.description: Switches the view to the sign-in pane.

methods.name: subscribeWithoutAccount
methods.description: Navigates to external webpage for subscription without creating an account.

methods.name: handleCreateAccount
methods.description: Validates form inputs and attempts to register a new user, managing side-effects.
